status: Visual design proposal only; no application code changes.
screen: 今天 — 记录历史滚动位置，饮食记录与运动记录同时展开
data_notice: Meal photos, dish names, dates and exercise values are illustrative examples, not actual user records.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity, implementable Chinese iPhone app screenshot showing the TODAY PAGE SCROLLED DOWN TO ITS RECORD HISTORY, with BOTH meal history and exercise history expanded. This is a design proposal, not a rendering of real account data.
Input image 1 is the exact user-approved VISUAL STYLE reference: the 称小二 home screen with a warm off-white canvas, confident deep indigo headings, apricot secondary accent, pale lavender food icon tiles, pale golden exercise icon tiles, white rounded cards, gentle shadows, clean simplified-Chinese typography and thin gray dividers. Closely match this look, the small apricot scale mascot logo, the same Chinese name "称小二" (first character 称, not 秤), the icon line weights, type hierarchy and four bottom tabs. Do not return to the old forest-green theme or a single-hue interface.
Asset: ONE full-bleed flat portrait mobile screenshot, aspect approximately 1024x2176, no physical phone frame, no surrounding presentation board, no annotations, no collages or multiple screens. Include realistic iOS safe areas and status bar. This is the lower scrolled portion of the existing Today page: the big encouragement slogan, metric cards and quick-action grid have already scrolled out of view; DO NOT shrink and cram them above the expanded history, and do not imply these functions have been removed.
Layout:
1. Quiet compact brand header at the top: approved apricot scale icon, "称小二", small warm-apricot sync chip "已同步". Beneath the header, title "记录历史" in deep indigo.
2. A generous but efficient WHITE rounded meal-history card. Section header with fork/spoon icon on a pale lavender rounded backplate, label "饮食记录" in indigo, and "收起" with an upward chevron at the right. It is clearly OPEN.
Meal entry one: muted date "10月29日", small apricot meal-type tag "午餐". At top right of this entry is an accessible circular pale-lavender PENCIL ICON button (no text "修改"). Under the date, a realistic rounded meal photo thumbnail on the LEFT (about 85-95 logical points square), showing a simple everyday Chinese lunch with rice, cauliflower and meat, and cabbage; on its right, clearly legible food list "米饭、花菜炒五花肉、清炒白菜", wrapped neatly across two lines. The picture is a thumbnail, not a large hero photograph; use a very subtle small expand indicator on the thumbnail to imply opening a full-size view.
Thin light divider.
Meal entry two: date "10月29日", small soft meal-type tag "早餐", another circular PENCIL ICON button at right. Food list "杂粮饭、蒸蛋、清炒菌菇" in dark readable text. This entry has NO PHOTO; do not render a missing-image box or invented photo. It should simply occupy less vertical space than the photo entry.
A restrained "加载更早" affordance at the bottom of the meal card.
3. A separate matching WHITE rounded exercise-history card, close beneath the meal card with a sensible 16-20 point gap. Section header running icon on pale golden-yellow rounded backplate, label "运动记录" in indigo, right "收起" with upward chevron, clearly OPEN.
Exercise entry one: muted "10月29日 18:20", primary title "快走", secondary line with small neat clock and footsteps icons and text "30 分钟" and "3,200 步". Optional subtle indigo/lavender pill backplates for these two data values, no heavy border.
Thin divider.
Exercise entry two: muted "10月28日 20:10", primary title "瑜伽", secondary line with clock icon "20 分钟". There is no step count for yoga: omit that field rather than inserting zero or a dash. NO pencil or editing button for exercise, since it has no implemented edit action.
A restrained "加载更早" affordance at the bottom of the exercise card.
4. Fixed bottom tab bar matching the reference, four evenly spaced tabs with icons and exact labels "今天", "教练", "趋势", "我的". 今天 is active with an indigo rounded icon backplate and warm-apricot sun detail, the other three are quiet gray outlines. Clear home-indicator inset; no content occluded by the tab bar.
Design constraints: The entire two expanded sections, including both meal examples and both exercise examples, must be comfortably readable in this scrolled viewport. Use compact realistic typography and appropriate whitespace, NOT a long infographic or an impossibly dense page. Match the original indigo-and-apricot consumer wellness design rather than an enterprise database table. Both section open/close controls are on the same baseline as their titles. Each meal pencil touch area is at least 44 logical points. Food names, occurrence dates, meal types and real optional exercise fields are the only record content. NO system replies, "已记录", "如需更正", "请告诉我", recognition uncertainties, nutrition assessments, medical tips, motivational text, calorie estimates, invented charts or numerical goals within records. No floating blue Expo gear, no trash icons or unrequested controls, no watermarks. All Chinese text must be sharp, correctly written and high contrast.
